Native source: Adventure travel map significant-structures panel

Images read directly:
  reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000
    D:/program/steam/steamapps/common/Dwarf Fortress/Dwarf Fortress.exe
  classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000
    C:/Users/WIN11/Downloads/df_53_16_win/Dwarf Fortress.exe

Ownership:
  Classic .?AVviewscreen_dungeonmodest@@ COL RVA 0x179a550,
  vtable RVA 0x16b4e38, render slot +0x18 RVA 0x7f1530..0x7f44a1.
  Its call RVA 0x7f433c invokes the travel/map renderer
  RVA 0x80ae60..0x81622c (reference RVA 0x80d5e0..0x8189ac).
  Panel body starts classic RVA 0x80eee1 and 0x811326;
  reference corresponding bodies start RVA 0x811661 and 0x813aa6.

Source scope:
  The two panel bodies contain 75 distinct literal operands: 72 whole finite
  captions, the suffix " shrine", and prefixes "Shrine to " and "Shrine of ".
  Repeated operands are retained with native call-site and literal RVAs in
  native-literals.tsv. Caption labels use RIP-relative source strings. The
  panel bodies contain no additional printable multi-byte inline literal labels.
  The complete switch targets, including cases that emit no caption, are in
  source-branches.tsv. Native machine instructions are retained in the two
  *-structures.asm files. These are extracted translation sources, not runtime
  output or a simulation of the game UI.

Panel selection and dimensions:
  The renderer obtains a current travel/map z level from the native selected
  coordinate or selected unit position. At classic RVA 0x80ed6c the comparison
  z>=1 selects the first panel; z<1 selects the second. Both panels occupy the
  rightmost 30 native columns, with text at panel_left+3. The first has border
  rows 1..11 and content rows 2..10; the second has border rows 1..20 and
  content rows 2..19. Row limiting is part of native rendering, not a text rule.

Site and cell selection:
  Iterate world_data.sites (world_data+0x178). Reject the native site+0x2a0
  predicate when true. Site x/y bounds at +0x1f8..+0x204 are multiplied by 3
  for the selected travel coordinate. The first branch also requires its z
  coordinate between site+0x348 and site+0x34c; the second requires
  site+0x348<=0. There must be a realization pointer at site+0x308.
  Selected local cell coordinates are derived from selected x/y minus the
  site's lower x/y bounds and then scaled 16/48. The realization grid uses
  local_x*17+local_y. Native flags at realization + cell*0xa8 +0xb518 have
  bit 0x100000 for the preceding "Sewer Access" line.
  Iterate structures from realization + cell*0x40 +0x17278. Each structure's
  type is +4, abstract building id +0x4c, info pointer +0x58, flags +0x78.

Main structure enum:
  Unsigned type<=31 guards both 32-entry switches. Enum names are corroborated
  with data/upstream/df-structures/df.site_realization.xml; the executable's
  switch determines which labels actually appear here.
  0 cottage_plot and 4 house => housing counters.
  1 castle_wall, 2 castle_tower, 3 castle_courtyard, 6 tomb, 10 pasture,
  11 waste, 12 courtyard, 14 vault, 15 great_tower, 27 meadow and
  30 necromancer_tower => no caption.
  5 temple => actual abstract name, otherwise Temple.
  7 shop_house => shop subtype, or Abandoned shop if flags&1.
  8 warehouse => Warehouse.
  9 market_square => market subtype, or Empty market if flags&1.
  13 well => Well. 16 trenches => Trenches.
  17 tree_house => tree subtype. 18 hillock_house => mound subtype.
  19 mead_hall => actual abstract name, otherwise Mead Hall.
  20 fortress_entrance => Fortress Entrance.
  21 library => actual abstract name, otherwise Library.
  22 tavern => actual abstract name, otherwise Tavern.
  23 counting_house => actual abstract name, otherwise Counting House.
  24 guild_hall => actual abstract name, otherwise Guildhall.
  25 city_tower => actual abstract name, otherwise Tower.
  26 shrine => practice caption or Shrine when info is null.
  28 dormitory => Dormitory.
  29 dininghall => Dining Hall in first branch, Dining hall in second branch.
  31 barrow => Barrow.
  NONE(-1), 32 mythical_palace, 33 mythical_dungeon and 34 mythical_lair in
  the local schema fall outside this native <=31 caption switch.

Subtypes:
  Tree info+8 values 0..8: Tree House, The Home Tree, Shaping Tree,
  Market Tree, Tavern Tree, Library Tree, Counting Tree, Guild Tree,
  Tower Tree. This renderer does not use tree_info.name.
  Mound info+8 values: 0 Residence => housing counters;
  1 Civic Mound; 2 Castle Mound; 3 Drinking Mound.
  Shop info+8 values 0..17: General imports, Food imports,
  Clothing imports, Cloth shop, Leather shop, Woven clothing shop,
  Leather clothing shop, Bone carver's shop, Gem cutter's shop,
  Weaponsmith's shop, Bowyer's shop, Blacksmith's shop, Armorsmith's shop,
  Metal craft shop, Leather goods shop, Carpenter's shop,
  Stone furniture shop, Metal furniture shop.
  Market info+8 values 18..24: Imported goods market, Imported food market,
  Imported clothing market, Meat market, Fruit and vegetable market,
  Cheese market, Processed goods market. Native subtraction of 18 produces
  the 0..6 jump table index. Shop icon tables draw glyphs separately and
  supply no extra prose captions.

Underground feature additions, first panel only:
  Iterate realization + cell*0xa8 +0xb538. Feature base type must be 7.
  feature+4 subtype 11 CIVILIZED_CONNECTION_FORTRESS => Underground Fortress;
  subtype 10 CIVILIZED_CONNECTION_FARMING => Underground Farms;
  subtype 8 CIVILIZED_LIVING => Underground Stair, only if feature+0x54!=-1.

Housing aggregation:
  cottage_plot, house and hillock_house.Residence do not each print a row.
  The renderer accumulates three groups. If flags&0x0a is nonzero, increment
  ruined; otherwise flags&1 increments abandoned; otherwise increment intact.
  This matches ruined and cz_ruined taking priority over abandoned.
  When site.type at +0x80 equals 3, the noun is Hillock/Hillocks. Otherwise
  the noun is House/Houses. A count of 1 prints singular, a count>1 plural,
  and a zero count prints no row. Finite captions are:
    House, Houses, Hillock, Hillocks;
    Abandoned house, Abandoned houses, Abandoned hillock, Abandoned hillocks;
    Ruined house, Ruined houses, Ruined hillock, Ruined hillocks.
  After all applicable rows, printed_row==2 emits one complete native string
  "No significant structures". "No" is not a separate Boolean caption.

Dynamic abstract building names:
  For the seven named structure types, resolve SRB.abstract_building_id
  through site.buildings+0x2b0 (classic helper 0x6fe90), call virtual getter
  at +0x10, then language_name formatter classic 0xa91760 / reference
  0xa946e0 with English=true and first-person=false. If id is -1, lookup
  fails or the getter returns null, print the category fallback above.
  The full language_name can be procedural or player-customized; no finite
  list of complete names can replace this source. Existing language/name
  translation must receive the complete row.

Shrine practice:
  A nonnull info pointer has religious_practice_type at +8 and practice id
  at +0xc. Enum 0 WORSHIP_HFID formats "Shrine to " + historical figure
  reference. Enum 1 RELIGION_ENID first finds the historical entity, then
  formats entity.name; first panel renders "{entity name} shrine", second
  panel renders "Shrine of {entity name}". Other practice values, or a
  missing religious entity in the guarded RELIGION_ENID branch, supply no
  additional label. A null info pointer emits the fixed caption Shrine.
  The RELIGION_ENID source is a historical entity name, not a sphere name.

Shrine helper source and reachable fallbacks:
  Entity formatter classic 0xb8f940..0xb8fab8 / reference 0xb92900 takes
  flags=0 here. It formats entity.name at +0x20 through language_name(true,
  false); LPAGE markup is disabled. Its general missing-entity fallback is
  "an unknown civilization", although this panel guards entity existence
  before calling it. Full helper instructions are classic-entity-name.asm.

  Figure formatter classic 0xb8ff50..0xb90967 / reference 0xb92f10 receives
  a fresh default reference context (classic constructor 0x72010), context
  flags=0, person IDs=-1, and the two word arguments 1,1. Thus no LPAGE
  markup, first-person pronouns, interrogator/subject role, or possessive
  suffix is generated for this panel. The helper can render:
    - named figure: full English generated/custom name at figure+0x38;
    - nameless figure: "a " + optional "zombie " + optional "ghostly " +
      creature/caste name via classic 0xaa0c50, optionally followed by a
      generated creature name held by figure+0x130 -> +0x48 -> +0x90;
    - missing figure: "an unknown creature".
  The nameless species/creature vocabulary comes from RAW data, not a
  bounded set of strings inside the renderer. The named-figure species
  suffix is disabled by the supplied word argument 1.
  General helper-only literals Nameless, an unidentified creature,
  interrogator, subject, myself, my, me, I, the, 's and LPAGE markers have
  been retained in helper-literals.tsv and full classic-figure-reference.asm;
  they are not all reachable with this panel's default context and arguments.
  The reachable unnamed-figure modifiers and unknown-creature fallback are
  source-derived; complete actor/name composition should use the established
  historical-figure/name and creature/caste translation pathways.
